generate_images_kandinsky: generate images from image embeddings using the KandinskyV22Pipeline with text-to-image generation
prepare_latents_pipeline: prepare initial noisy latents for the KandinskyV22Pipeline diffusion model generation process
downscale_dimensions: downscale height and width dimensions by a scale factor for latent space processing
configure_classifier_free_guidance: configure classifier-free guidance for the KandinskyV22Pipeline by setting guidance scale greater than 1
decode_latents_to_images: decode latents to final images using the MoVQ decoder in the KandinskyV22Pipeline
